_comment_h6: Bug-1 reproducer for realistic (multi-second) watchdog values. Same workload structure as bug1_canonical.json (16 oversubscribed yes-loop workers, 4x nproc with nr_cpus=4) but with a stretched cgroup quota window so the bug-1 stall persists past the canonical 100ms throttle period: cpu.max=10000 5000000 (0.2% over 5s period) yields a contiguous throttle window of ~4990ms — large enough to trip watchdogs of 1s, 2s, and 4s with byte-identical determinism.
_comment_run_units: rt-app 'run' is microseconds. 10000000us = 10s per task per loop iteration, ensuring the loop iteration outlives any of the {1s,2s,4s} watchdog tiers without rolling over.
_comment_invocation: Verified invocations: --watchdog 1s --duration 2000ms (runnable_for_ns=1000003099), --watchdog 2s --duration 3000ms (runnable_for_ns=2000013593), --watchdog 4s --duration 5000ms (runnable_for_ns=4000035190). All exit 42 with byte-identical stderr across 3 reps. Pair with bug1_canonical.toml (enable_cpu_bw=true).
